terms.comment: Our functional description. For an individual panel, tabula, tabulae f. is a useful broad noun; the precise material should be specified separately.

Our working formation, not an attested term, built on classical spūmeus, spūmea, spūmeum “foamy” (Vergil, Ovid, Pliny). Gloss: tabula levissima ex māteriā artificiōsā spūmeā facta, quae parietibus forīs affīgitur, ut domus hieme calōrem retineat et aestāte frīgus. The common boards on site are black, graphite EPS, not white.

phrases.english: Don’t make holes in this board.
